assertions.description: GGM eq (21) diagonal entry S+_{11}(1;0) = 1 != 3 = S+_{12}(1;0), off-diagonal tower [3,9,75,642,5580,48558] is divisible by 3, and s(x) = x^-1 + 1 + x gives s(1) = 3 and s(1)+1 = 4 across 4_1 and 5_2.
Candidate A (|disc|) and Candidate B (|Delta middle coeff|) agree at 4_1 (3 = 3) and split by 20 at 5_2 (23 vs 3), with 23 absent from 5_2 off-diagonal entries.
Linear functional L(a,b) = alpha*a + beta*b is iota-odd on (4,3) iff alpha + beta = 0; primitive iota-odd functional gives 1 on 5_2 and 0 on 4_1, excluding iota-even sum 7.
Every all-odd-weight (including +/-1 LCI) stratification over chi_eu = -2 has even DT count (never 3); minimal 2-stratum witness [(2,5), (1,-7)] requires even weight n_1 = 2.
Bring genus-4 curve has chi_eu = -6 and Gromov simplicial volume ||X_Bring|| = 12, while ||S^3 \ 4_1|| = Vol(4_1)/v_3 = 2 at 80 dps.
Stallings monodromy M_{4_1} = R*L = [[2,1],[1,1]] has tr = 3, det = 1, disc = 5, and z0 = z1 = e^{i pi/3} satisfies z0*z1*(1-z0)*(1-z1) = 1 to < 1e-75.
Neumann-Zagier symplectic intersection pairing gives omega_NZ(mu, lambda) = -2 and edge isotropy omega_NZ(e_1, e_2) = 0.
|disc(Q(zeta_3))| = 3 and |disc(Q(zeta_5))| = 125 = 5^3 have gcd = 1, certifying that Q(zeta_3) does not embed into Bring's field Q(zeta_5).
